conditions.order: alternating fresh native and ingestion processes
conditions.interpretation: Observed workload totals; no campaign extrapolation. Scalar differences are reported, never rounded away. Runtime/import and generation memory differ from ingestion.

overhead_accounting: Shared source and pre-existing runtime are counted once, separate from run totals. Native code may be inside the runtime; these inventories must not be summed without deduplication. Sizes are regular-file lengths, exclude symlinks, filesystem allocation and OS libraries. The executable target is separate. Native round_market blobs are included in each run total and also itemized. No retention migration or replay runtime is used.

grid_launch_overhead.scope: Actual launch_identity helper, source snapshot, runtime identity JSON and portable manifest comment. No strategy execution or Project run journal is included in this overhead probe; native campaign run totals exclude these separately measured Grid wrapper artifacts.
